concepts.title: Temperature Scale Conversion between Celsius and Fahrenheit
concepts.definition: Numerical temperature values on Fahrenheit and Celsius scales relate through linear interpolation between the ice point and steam point.
concepts.key_idea: An interval of 180 units on the Fahrenheit scale corresponds to 100 units on the Celsius scale.

concepts.title: Kelvin and Celsius Absolute Temperature Relation
concepts.definition: The absolute thermodynamic scale uses Kelvin units where zero corresponds to minimum kinetic state at -273.15 degrees Celsius.
concepts.key_idea: Adding 273.15 to a Celsius reading shifts it to the absolute thermodynamic Kelvin scale.

concepts.key_idea: Thermal stress equals Young's modulus multiplied by thermal strain caused by temperature shift.

concepts.title: Principle of Calorimetry
concepts.definition: In an isolated system, total heat lost by hotter components equals total heat gained by cooler components during thermal equilibration.
concepts.key_idea: Energy conservation in isolated thermal mixing ensures thermal equilibrium when net heat exchange is zero.
